title: Not Thrown About
logline: A worker handles, hour after hour, what most people turn away from, without flinching and without hardening, and talks plainly about how they got that way.
human_question: What is the difference between not caring and simply not being thrown off balance by what you meet?

situation.what_happens: Someone whose daily work involves what others find repulsive does it steadily, competently and without display. The steadiness is neither indifference nor stoicism on show; it is what the job requires and what long practice produced. Asked about it, the person usually says something plainer and less flattering than the film expects.
situation.who_is_involved: The worker; colleagues who do the same work and talk about it differently; customers or members of the public who keep their distance; the family who knows what the work is.
situation.what_is_at_stake: Dignity, mostly. This is low-status work and a film can easily make a symbol of the worker, or trade on disgust. For the worker, being seen doing it may carry a social cost.
situation.how_it_unfolds: The work is shift-shaped and repetitive, with unpleasant moments that arrive without warning. The pressure is physical and social rather than dramatic. It ends with the shift. Reality decides whether the worker wants to reflect on it at all, and the film accepts a shrug as an answer.

concept_merge.why_together: C090 (the ten kinds of supernormal power) contributes a ranking that is easy to miss: among ten kinds, from the spectacular to the ordinary, one is said to belong to the fully freed alone, and it is not a feat at all but dwelling without revulsion toward the repulsive, without being pulled by the alluring, and evenly toward both [C090-P4:L85–L87; C090-M:L13]. C089 (the direct knowledges) contributes the sources' insistence that nothing of this kind comes from wishing and that the hardest use of any of it is composure when someone else is suddenly in danger.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: Put together, the tradition's own list turns out to put its highest mark on an inner response rather than a display, and that reframes what the group has been calling power. Watching ordinary steadiness in work others avoid gives that ranking a human scale without ever suggesting the worker is what the texts describe.

concept_links.why: The source defines the noble kind of power as dwelling without revulsion toward what is repulsive, without attraction to the alluring, or evenly toward both, and says it belongs to the fully freed alone [C090-P4:L85–L87; C090-M:L13]. The film watches an ordinary human form of that steadiness and must never suggest the worker has any attainment. The digest also warns against turning the source's protection stories into a promise that good people are safe.

The sources say plainly that wishing achieves nothing and that these capacities rest on long, rule-bound training, and they present the powers only as what the texts describe. The worker's composure is offered as an echo, not an instance.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: In the texts' own ranking, the mark they reserve for the fully freed is not a spectacular feat but an even response to what disgusts and what attracts, and that is a thing ordinary steadiness can point at without claiming.
what_must_be_real: The worker's real job and their own account of it, filmed with dignity and full consent. No claim of any inner attainment is made or implied, and the powers the texts describe are presented only as what the texts describe.
position_hint: middle if kept separately: it belongs with the group's films about what the texts call power, before the final withdrawal and closing films.
risks: Exploiting low-status labour for a spiritual message
Gore or sensationalism in the imagery
The worker becoming a symbol rather than a person
Implying the worker has attained anything
drop_if: No worker will consent to be filmed and interviewed on their own terms
The work cannot be shown without trading on disgust

connections.note: Its substance, the least spectacular of the ten kinds and the steadiness that is not indifference, now sits inside the readiness film.

selection.reason: It carries the strongest reading of C090 and strengthens IDEA-0185, which holds the episode slot.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
